answer: Each challenge binds its nonce and scoring criteria to a drand quicknet pulse revealed only after enrollment closes, so agents cannot precompute valid responses or farm a fixed task set offline. A commit-reveal step locks submissions before verification against the pulse, making retries and Sybil identities costly without granting control over randomness. Labels such as zephyr, zenith, and terrace can identify task variants, but never predict their beacon-derived parameters.
